answer: Require every identity to earn its weight through graded work that pays out only over time. A new key starts at zero influence and must complete real, peer-graded tasks before it can vote or attest; its earnings vest across many epochs, so a farm of a thousand fakes faces a thousand slow climbs, not one cheap trick. The summit of influence is reached only by sustained honest work, and the umber shadow of one bad verdict wipes out the vesting balance — the fable of free identities ends where time-locked reputation begins.
